introduction: MFIP combines cash and food assistance with employment support for eligible families with children and pregnant applicants.
description: MFIP combines cash and food assistance with employment support for eligible families with children and pregnant applicants.

sections.who: An income and asset screen applies, along with verification. Most caregivers face a cumulative 60-month limit; ask about your individual circumstances.
sections.get: Families receive cash and food through EBT. Employment services and possible child-care help support work or education.
sections.docs:
• Household, pregnancy or child information.
  • Income and asset records.
  • Documents requested for the interview.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use MNbenefits, or submit a paper application to the county or Tribal Nation.

  2. Attend an interview

    Complete the local office’s phone or in-person interview and verification.

  3. Discuss an employment plan

    Ask the caseworker about required activities, child care and relevant exceptions.
sections.after: Read benefit notices, follow the employment plan and report changes.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using MFIP benefits and application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
